title: Quotient line endpoint coherence under scalar pullback
statement: Fix prime l, E, π, n and f:X→S. Let e0 be an integral PullEndpoint normalized by spIntegralComparison. Let eS,eX be scalar Endpoints for the actual quotientLineMap at S,X. Let m satisfy QuotientPullMap and let e be a quotient PullEndpoint normalized by m. The comparison of [def-diagonal-scalar-pullback-comparison] on the shifted integral line, followed by derived quotient pullback of eS.shift and by e.shift, equals derived scalar extension of e0.shift followed by eX.shift. No diagram, diagonal class, supported source, or trace is assumed. Endpoints and quotient tensor normalization are as in [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-endpoints], [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-pullback-endpoints], and [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-family-pullback].

proof.text: Transpose through the scalar adjunction. Endpoint normalization and the exact-single comparison reduce to the ordinary semilinear square. PullEndpoint normalization and QuotientPullMap identify this square after the epic pulled-back tensor quotient map. Cancel it and use faithfulness of module maps.

The comparison is the scalar adjunction mate of the exact restriction/pullback comparison. Its compatibility with the adjunction shift structures, and naturality of shift comparisons, shifts the ordinary endpoint identity by two.

theorem diagonalQuotient_linePullbackNormalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers l E) (n : ℕ)
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (e₀ : PullEndpoint (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.{u} l E.1) f
      (spIntegralTwist S l E) (spIntegralTwist X l E) (spIntegralComparison f l E))
    (eS : Endpoint (quotientMap l E π n) (spIntegralTwist S l E)
      (quotientLine l E π n S) (quotientLineMap l E π n S))
    (eX : Endpoint (quotientMap l E π n) (spIntegralTwist X l E)
      (quotientLine l E π n X) (quotientLineMap l E π n X))
    (m : (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (quotientLine l E π n S).X ⟶
      (quotientLine l E π n X).X)
    (hm : QuotientPullMap l E π n f m)
    (e : PullEndpoint
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n)) f
      (quotientLine l E π n S) (quotientLine l E π n X) m) :
    ScalarPullbackEndpointSquare (quotientMap l E π n) f e₀ eS eX e
